items.title: Pay painting invoice
items.quote: Bitte überweisen Sie den Betrag innerhalb von 14 Tagen nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung auf unser Konto.
items.computation: The invoice itself carries no printed issue date (only 'Rechnung Nr. 26/077' and the work-completion date 12.08.2026 are given), and the letter does not state when it was received. Payment is due 14 days after receipt of the invoice ('nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung'), a private-law period governed by §§ 187, 188 BGB, not the administrative deemed-delivery rules (this is a company, not an authority). Lacking any stated receipt date, the earliest plausible anchor is the day the work was completed and presumably invoiced, 12.08.2026: the day of receipt itself is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB), so the 14-day period runs from 13.08.2026 through 26.08.2026. That day, Wednesday 26.08.2026, is a business day in NRW, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB applies. Because the true invoice date and actual receipt date are unknown, this is only the earliest plausible due date; if the invoice was actually sent or received later, the real due date is correspondingly later.

warnings: The invoice shows no issue date of its own (only the work-completion date 12.08.2026 and no stated posting or receipt date), so the 14-day payment period 'nach Erhalt dieser Rechnung' could not be anchored with certainty; 26.08.2026 is only the earliest plausible due date and should be checked against the envelope postmark or actual receipt date.

The IBAN DE10 3705 0198 0001 2345 60 is well-formed and matches the letterhead's bank (Musterbank AG, BLZ 37050198), but this only confirms the IBAN's format, not that it belongs to Malerbetrieb Muster — verify against a previous invoice or the company's known bank details before paying.
